name: codotheca
description: A library for the code you have written

scripts.build: npm run gen && npm run build:core && npm run build:app
scripts.dev: npm run gen && npm run dev --workspace app
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace app && cargo clippy --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml && npm run test --workspace app
